desc: 到 ML 管理面端口（Ray 8265 / 推理管理 30000 / 训练控制 9000）的非白名单来源连接。English: non-allowlisted source connecting to ML admin-plane ports.
condition: (evt.type=connect and fd.l4proto=tcp) and (fd.sport in (8265, 30000, 9000)) and not fd.cip in (admin_allowlist)
output: admin-plane connection src=%fd.cip sport=%fd.sport proc=%proc.name container=%container.name

tuning.zh: admin_allowlist 宏先填 bastion/调度器网段；对 8265/30000/9000 之外的自部署管理端口按端口清单追加；无 driver 部署下依赖网络事件源（auditd/ebpf 二选一）
tuning.en: Populate the admin_allowlist macro with bastion/scheduler CIDRs first; append self-deployed admin ports to the port list; without the driver, rely on auditd or eBPF network event source

rule: TRIDENT Pickle deserialization in serving/training process
desc: 服务/训练进程外的 pickle/torch.load/recv_pyobj 反序列化调用（检查点与权重通道）。English: pickle/torch.load/recv_pyobj deserialization outside the trainer baseline.
condition: evt.type in (syscall.primative, retval) and proc.name in (python, python3, raylet, sglang-server) and evt.arg.data startswith b'pickle' or lib in (pickle, torch.load, recv_pyobj)
output: deserialize call proc=%proc.name lib=%lib channel=%channel obj=%obj.source

tuning.zh: 以训练基线进程清单（torchrun/trainer）收敛 proc 白名单；通道字段区分 checkpoint-socket / weights-load / shared-volume；weights_only=True 迁移完成后可升 ERROR
tuning.en: Constrain proc names to the training baseline (torchrun/trainer); keep a channel field to separate checkpoint-socket / weights-load / shared-volume; raise to ERROR once weights_only=True migration completes

rule: TRIDENT Weight file write by non-training process
desc: 非训练进程对权重/检查点/HF 缓存路径的写打开（权重投毒与偷换一体面）。English: write-open on weight/checkpoint/HF-cache paths by a non-training process.
condition: (evt.type in (open, openat, openat2) and evt.is_open_write=true) and fd.name icontains (checkpoints, weights, hf-cache, models) and not proc.name in (trainer, torchrun, accelerate)

tuning.zh: 路径关键字按客户挂载点校准（/checkpoints、/models、hf_cache、safetensors）；训练进程名单按调度器主体固化；RWX 共享卷路径建议整体纳入
tuning.en: Calibrate path keywords to customer mount points (/checkpoints, /models, hf_cache, safetensors); pin the training process list to scheduler identities; include RWX shared-volume paths wholesale

rule: TRIDENT Collective communication join by external rank
desc: 集合通信（NCCL bootstrap / TCPStore / KV 传输）出现外部 rank 入组或跨域加入。English: external rank joining collective communication (NCCL bootstrap / TCPStore / KV transfer).
condition: evt.type in (connect, accept) and evt.arg.channel in (collective, kv-cache-transfer, rdma-fabric) and not k8s.ns.label in (training-allowlist) and evt.arg.external_rank=true
output: collective join channel=%evt.arg.channel rank_src=%fd.cip port=%fd.sport ns=%k8s.ns.name

tuning.zh: training-allowlist 按调度器生成的训练命名空间标签维护；channel 枚举对齐实际集合通信栈（NCCL/DeepEP/NIXL/Mooncake）；RDMA 面事件依赖 eBPF/SM 导出（IB 面无 NetworkPolicy，见 ib-partition-advice.yaml）
tuning.en: Maintain training-allowlist from scheduler-generated namespace labels; align the channel enum with the actual collective stack (NCCL/DeepEP/NIXL/Mooncake); RDMA-plane events need eBPF/SM export (no NetworkPolicy on IB - see ib-partition-advice.yaml)

rule: TRIDENT GPU device mounted across namespaces
desc: 同一 /dev/nvidia* 设备被不同 namespace 的进程同时打开（device plugin/MIG 独占失效）。English: same GPU device opened by processes in different namespaces.
condition: evt.type in (mount, open, openat) and fd.name startswith /dev/nvidia and not k8s.ns.name in (gpu-exclusive-allowlist)
output: GPU device cross-ns open device=%fd.name proc=%proc.name ns=%k8s.ns.name pod=%k8s.pod.name

tuning.zh: gpu-exclusive-allowlist 先放 GPU operator/驱动 DaemonSet 命名空间；跨 namespace 判定以 k8s.ns.name 为准（同一 Pod 多容器不触发）；MIG 场景按 /dev/nvidia-caps 细分
tuning.en: Populate gpu-exclusive-allowlist with the GPU operator/driver DaemonSet namespace first; judge cross-namespace by k8s.ns.name (multi-container pods do not trigger); for MIG, split by /dev/nvidia-caps

desc: nvidia-smi/nvml 在已分配设备上执行 MIG 重配或非常规档位切换（隔离边界被改写）。English: nvidia-smi/nvml MIG reconfiguration or unusual profile switch on an allocated device.
output: MIG reconfig proc=%proc.name device=%evt.arg.device profile=%evt.arg.profile user=%user.name

tuning.zh: 维护窗口内的计划重配按工单白名单；已分配设备上的 MIG 变更一律告警；结合 /gpu/mig/profiles 的 active/requested 差值确认隔离降级
tuning.en: Allowlist planned maintenance-window reconfigurations by ticket; alert on any MIG change on allocated devices; correlate with the active/requested delta from /gpu/mig/profiles

rule: TRIDENT AI gateway process reads upstream provider credentials
desc: AI 网关进程（litellm/higress/envoy）读取上游 provider 凭据配置（/config、/etc/litellm、provider-secrets 挂载），或非网关主体读取同一路径。English: gateway or foreign process reading upstream provider credential config.
condition: evt.type in (open, openat, openat2) and evt.is_open_read=true and fd.name contains (/config, /etc/litellm, provider-secrets) and proc.name in (litellm, higress, envoy) and not proc.name in (gateway-startup-allowlist)
output: gateway config read proc=%proc.name file=%fd.name container=%container.name

tuning.zh: 网关自身启动期读取配置为正常基线（按启动窗口抑制）；运行期再次读取 /config 或 provider-secrets 挂载应告警；非网关进程读取同一路径建议升级 CRITICAL，并与 Sigma 的 admin API 无鉴权调用联动
tuning.en: Treat startup reads by the gateway as baseline (suppress during startup window); alert on runtime re-reads of /config or provider-secrets mounts; escalate to CRITICAL for non-gateway processes and correlate with the no-auth admin API Sigma rule

rule: TRIDENT In-network collective reduce poisoned by external member
desc: 在网聚合 reduce 结果被外部成员篡改（all-reduce 静默损坏面）。English: in-network collective reduce result tampered by an external session member.
condition: evt.type in (connect, accept) and evt.arg.channel in (sharp-aggregation, in-network-collective) and evt.arg.tampered=true and not k8s.ns.label in (training-allowlist)
output: collective poison channel=%evt.arg.channel rank_src=%fd.cip result_delta=%evt.arg.delta ns=%k8s.ns.name

tuning.zh: 需要 fabric 控制器/交换机导出 reduce 会话事件（含 tampered 标记与结果差分）；与 sigma-fabric-sharp-unauth-join 联动区分「入组尝试」与「结果已被篡改」；命中即 critical
tuning.en: Requires fabric controller/switch export of reduce-session events (tampered flag + result delta); correlate with sigma-fabric-sharp-unauth-join to separate join attempts from actual result tampering; keep hits critical

rule: TRIDENT Fabric control-plane config mutated by unauthorized subject
desc: fabric 控制面配置（IB Partition 成员 / PFC 档位 / rail 绑定 / GPU 健康 Xid）被未授权主体改写。English: unauthorized mutation of fabric control-plane config (IB partition / PFC / rail binding / GPU health).
condition: evt.type in (open, openat, openat2) and evt.is_open_write=true and evt.arg.component in (pfc, partition, rail, xid) and not proc.name in (fabric-operator-allowlist)
output: fabric config write component=%evt.arg.component proc=%proc.name src=%fd.cip container=%container.name

tuning.zh: component 枚举对齐客户 fabric 控制器（SM/PFC Agent/拓扑服务/GPU 健康服务）；写主体白名单=网络 operator 与驱动 DaemonSet；storm 档与 Xid 复位族直接 critical
tuning.en: Align the component enum with the customer fabric controllers (SM/PFC agent/topology service/GPU health service); allowlist writers = network operator and driver DaemonSets; escalate storm profiles and reset-class Xid writes to critical

rule: TRIDENT Node root proof marker write from privileged container
desc: ??????? /root ?? TRIDENT-PROOF ????? root ?????English: privileged container writes a TRIDENT-PROOF marker into host /root.
condition: (evt.type in (open, openat, openat2) and evt.is_open_write=true) and fd.name contains TRIDENT-PROOF and container.privileged=true
output: node-root marker write path=%fd.name proc=%proc.name container=%container.name

tuning.en: Keep TRIDENT-PROOF as the assessment marker; in production include all host-path writes under /root, /etc, /var/lib/kubelet; any privileged container host-path write is critical
